advanced-filter-description: Nsɛm mu yiyiyi a ɛkɔ akyiri no ma wutumi kyerɛw nsɛm a ɛwɔ ahyɛde yi: == != <= >= && || ( ) Fa ntam kwan tetew ahyɛde no mu. Wubetumi ayi afã a woahyɛ da ayɛ nyinaa mu denam wɔn din ne botae a wobɛkyerɛw so. Sɛ nhwɛso no: Field1 == Value1. Hyɛ no nsow: sɛ afã anaa botae no wɔ ntam kwan a, fa hyɛ nsɛm a wɔafa mu sɛnkyerɛnne biako mu. Sɛ nhwɛso no: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wɔfa agyiraehyɛde (' \/) sɛ nsɛm kɛkɛ a, fa \ di kan. Sɛ nhwɛso no: Field1 == I\'m. Wubetumi aka tebea pii abom nso. Sɛ nhwɛso no: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Wɔtaa kenkan ahyɛde nyinaa fi benkum kɔ nifa. Wubetumi de nkahyɛmu asesa ntoatoaso no. Sɛ nhwɛso no: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Wubetumi de regex ahwehwɛ nsɛm afã nso: F1 == /Tes.*/i

r-wrike-workflow-note: Wrike adwuma kwan yɛ tebea ahodoɔ nhwɛso, na biara wɔ Active, Completed, Deferred anaa Cancelled kuo mu. Yi adi kyerɛw bɔɔd yi nhwɛso sɛ adwuma kwan baako, a wɔde bɔɔd no din too so, wɔ JSON a Wrike API de ma adwuma akwan mu: yɛ saa adwuma kwan no wɔ Wrike mu ansa na wode bɔɔd no Wrike Excel a wɔayi adi aba mu, sɛdeɛ ne tebea bɛyɛ adwuma. Fa ba mu kenkan JSON a wɔde ahyɛ mu wɔ soro no, fi WeKan anaa Wrike GET /workflows, kɔ bɔɔd a wɔapaw no mu: tebea a nhwɛso nni hɔ ma no bɛyɛ nhwɛso, na mmara bi hyɛ kaad agyiraeɛ sɛ awie sɛ wɔde kɔ Completed anaa Cancelled tebea mu, na ɛnwieeɛ sɛ ɛwɔ Active anaa Deferred mu. Wontumi nyi Wrike ankasa automation mmara mfi Wrike mu.
